notes.title: Gamepad Patch
notes.content:
The game now accepts inputs from any and all gamepads connected to your PC (or Steam Deck).

If external gamepads still do not work with Steam Deck, or other issues result from this patch, feel free to share. Thanks!

notes.title: A Little Update!
notes.content:
To help maintain the longevity of Overbowed, I've updated it to the most recent version of GameMaker Studio 2. This created some issues, but I've worked them out (if you find any annoying or game breaking bugs/crashes, please share!).

In addition to this conversion, I've implemented the following new features to the game:
[list]
[*]Map pins,
[*]Shop item descriptions,
[*]Save and Quit (you'll keep all progress but respawn at the last mushroom save spot)
[/list]

Thanks for supporting the game so far! Overbowed will be participating in the upcoming Steam Spring Sale, so stay tuned for that!

notes.title: Update Notes for June 2nd
notes.content:
Update Notes (v 1.002):

-The map now shows the boundaries of large rooms. If a large room is not completely explored, it's easy to see this.
-Various audio fixes.
-Bramble upgrade change for quality of life.
